proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C h
  have hBC : B ≠ C := ne₂₃_of_not_collinear h
  have e1 := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos A B C
  have e2 := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos A C B
  rw [dist_comm C B] at e1
  have hp : dist B C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hBC
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hp
  linear_combination (-1 / 2) * e1 + (-1 / 2) * e2
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → dist B C = dist A B * Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) + dist A C * Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A C B)
